command:
date --iso-8601=seconds
uname -r
apt-cache policy linux-image-generic linux-generic linux-image-7.0.0-42-generic
stat -c '%n %y %s' /var/lib/apt/periodic/update-success-stamp /var/lib/apt/lists/*InRelease
apt list --upgradable 2>/dev/null
systemctl --failed --no-pager
dpkg --audit
if test -e /run/reboot-required; then cat /run/reboot-required /run/reboot-required.pkgs; else echo NO_REBOOT_REQUIRED; fi
systemd-analyze cat-config systemd/journald.conf | grep -E '^ForwardToWall='
